contract: construct(n_rows, k) -> list of n_rows rows; the evaluator passes this task's n_rows and k. Each row is a list of k + 1 integers that starts at 0 and increases strictly. Valid when all positive differences a_j - a_i (i < j) inside the rows are distinct over all rows. Score: the scope, the largest entry, minimized; it is an upper bound on m(n_rows, k).
notes: Independent exact verifier of all within-row differences. The published record construction for every task was scored with this evaluator and reproduces the published value exactly (validation/human-results/frontier_combinatorics.json). The record sets of Shehadeh, Kingsford and Kschischang (2025) were read from their GitHub repository (MIT). Unit tests check optimal Golomb rulers (one-row sets) and reject repeated differences.
protocol_description: Locally implemented evaluator with recorded reference checks; consult the task-specific tests and evidence for their exact scope. This label alone does not establish reproduction of the paper's full experiment.
name: Difference triangle set (4,7)
description: Choose 4 rows of 8 increasing integers starting at 0 so that all differences between two entries of the same row are distinct over all rows, with the largest entry as small as possible. The best known set has largest entry 134 (Shehadeh, Kingsford and Kschischang, 2025); the simple counting bound is 112.
paper_metric: Local protocol; see candidate contract and source adaptation notes

sources.locator: Shehadeh, Kingsford and Kschischang, J. Combin. Des. 34(1) (2026) 37-50 (CC BY 4.0; arXiv:2502.19517), Table I: m(4,7) <= 134, previous best 135; only the (14,4) and (15,4) sets are claimed optimal.
The (4,7) set of scope 134 found by the FPGA search (MIT).
Klove (1989), Bounds and construction for difference triangle sets: the problem, its use for convolutional self-orthogonal codes and lower bounds.

limitations: Differs from the catalog's Sidon-set tasks: those ask for one or two Sidon sets in a fixed interval, whereas this asks for 4 rulers with jointly distinct differences and minimizes the largest mark.
Only the counting bound n k (k+1) / 2 = 112 is reported by the evaluator; stronger linear-programming lower bounds exist in the literature.

The record construction is public, so a candidate can reproduce the record by embedding it; the score measures the returned object, not the search that produced it, and only a strictly smaller score than the best known value is a new result.
Candidate Python runs inside the evaluator process as trusted research code; the evaluator recomputes every property of the returned object exactly and trusts nothing the candidate reports.

science_relevance.scientific_problem: Determine m(4,7), the least scope of a difference triangle set with 4 rows of 8 marks whose within-row differences are all distinct.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: Difference triangle sets yield convolutional self-orthogonal codes for threshold decoding and are used in radar and communication waveform design and in higher-order staircase codes; their minimal scopes are known only for small parameters, and a smaller scope gives shorter code memory and lower decoding complexity.
